meta.title: Decommissioning: Each Step Forecloses a Rollback Option

views.label: Never skip ahead
views.note: Pausing jobs and revoking write access are both fully reversible -- un-pause or re-grant and you are back.

views.label: Step 3 is the gate
views.note: Verify every export from the target, not the source, before freezing non-admin access.

views.label: Storage deletion is the point of no return
views.note: Deleting a workspace leaves the metastore and data intact. Deleting storage leaves nothing recoverable.

cards.title: Every step forecloses a rollback option
items: Pausing jobs and revoking write access are both fully reversible -- un-pause or re-grant and you are back
Never skip ahead because a later step is cheaper -- the order exists because each step depends on the last being clean

cards.title: Step 3 is the gate -- everything after is mechanical
items: Verify every export by querying it FROM the target, not assuming the job that wrote it succeeded
Two failure modes this catches: an export written somewhere the target can't read, and a job that silently stopped early

cards.title: Deleting a workspace is not deleting the data
items: Workspace deletion removes objects only -- metastore and storage survive
Metastore deletion removes catalog structure and grants -- storage still survives
Storage deletion is the only truly irreversible step -- keep it on a lifecycle policy for a quarter first
